title: Review the common-map tensor-pairing bound independently.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independent confirmation of PR #3928 sections 2–5. Audit of one embedding obstruction. No new decoder, supplier, or kappa. Selected conditional kappa stays `0.001672660197076918`.

The sixteen-point tensor pairing `B = (G4 + J) mod 2` squares to `I_16` over F2, so its rank is 16. No 9-bit bilinear form, with any source map, reader map, or repeated labels, can preserve the full pairing. Every one of the 65,536 principal restrictions has rank `2p` when it contains only complement pairs and `2p+1` when it has a singleton. The largest set of rank at most 9 has size 12. That size-12 witness is not a common-map embedding: its four singleton rows are identical, and a rank-9 Gram matrix `A H A^T` with invertible `H` then forces those labels to coincide.

A common injective map to norm-2 E8 root lines has positive-definite Gram rank `|S|`, hence `|S| ≤ 8`. Eight explicit roots in the 112-line complement of the coordinate frame attain the bound. Injectivity is necessary: nine tensor indices preserve `B` on three lines. The predecessor identity `D T^T = 2 G4` asks for coefficient 16 on witness cross pair `(0, 1)`, where the root Gram entry is 0. Dividing `G4` by 8 leaves 2, still not 0.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f` (canonical `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` main; priority revision 6).
- Task: `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, scope **refined**. The card asks for a larger-rank local word. This session reviews the embedding obstruction that already blocks this rank-16 pairing on nine-bit labels.
- Ordered eligible handoffs, chronological on #1166, after dropping items whose next task is already delivered or matched by an open PR title, and after dropping the flag-9 head-step repair in #4107:
  1. Fresh full replay of the PR #3605 portable wrapper (comment 19016211).
  2. Typed actual-width physical H / rounded return (comment 19016699).
  3. Single-hub two-bearing factorization of PR #3573 (comment 19021149).
  4. Bind the QQ16 six-tape axis primitive to one literal caller (comment 19030049).
  5. **Independent review of the tensor-pairing embedding boundary (comment 19030180). This session.**
- Excluded before that cut: the L22 census handoff later marked DONE; the P104 residual consumer (open #3943); the T385 full replay (open #3936); the neutral-first retiming (open #3941 and #3957). Flag-9 (#4107) was released later the same day and does not change this fifth slot.
- Predecessor under review: PR #3928, head `2b2daaecac95e1048923d22fda51ccd01780565f`. This package does not import its code.
- Not redone: a separate-map search, a new block decoder, or the eight-term all-pairs floor.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3. Registered replay:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/tensor-pairing-common-map-review
```

Passed locally as `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/tensor-pairing-common-map-review outcome=completed`.

- `verify.py` rebuilds the Kronecker Gram, checks the square identity, all 65,536 principal ranks, the 120-line E8 alphabet, the eight-root witness, the nine abstract labels, the size-12 row obstruction, and the noninjective three-line map.
- `independent.py` does not import that file. It recomputes the square, the witness Gram, and the frozen nine labels.
- `test_verify.py` rejects a broken complement, a nonzero cross-pair Gram entry, and an altered label.

Direct `-I -O` runs of the two scanners also passed. Not run: a re-derivation of PR #3566 port indices, a separate source/reader-map search, Lean, Docker, or a selected cold replay. The sentence "attained at selected ports 0, 76, 28, 86, 103, 17, 10, 11" is not re-authenticated; the eight roots are checked only as members of the standard 112-line complement.

## Credit

ToikY for PR #3928 and the released review request. homelab-05 / 1337isnot1337 for PR #3895. Gonzalo Mier for the PR #3566 port bijection, which this review cites and does not re-derive. The E8 frame convention follows the retained P112 model. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can different source and reader maps embed one principal set of size 9, 10, 11, or 12 and still match `2 G4`? The common-map cap does not forbid it. Start with one fixed nine-point index set. A label pair is not a decoder until dirty inputs, frames, restoration, and the recursive bill are priced.
2. Does every common injective eight-point witness miss `2 G4` on a cross pair? Classifying them needs the PR #3566 port pin before selected labels can be cited.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The explicit numbered index in #1166 has four questions, but three of those next tasks already have open PRs. The fifth remaining handoff only appears once earlier prose handoffs are kept in chronological order. A machine-readable open-handoff list that drops requests whose next task is already an open PR would make parallel sessions agree without reconstructing that filter.
